sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed the discography-view (Complete/Official/Non-Official/Complete (merged)) master-toggle "Show/Hide all sub-sections" button getting permanently out of sync with the actual collapse state after switching views — most visible on a view where nothing auto-expands (e.g. the Non-Official view with no "Album" category). Clicking the desynced button was worse: it unconditionally showed/hid every sub-table on the page, including ones belonging to a currently-filtered-out view, dumping unexpected headerless content into the page while that view's own section headers correctly stayed hidden. The button now resyncs on every render (not just the first) and its click handler now correctly skips sub-tables that aren't part of the current discography view.

Fixed sorting a column in a multi-table page's sub-table, then switching discography views, losing the sort's visual indicators (column header tint, sort-glyph highlight, body zebra striping, and per-table sort-status text) even though the underlying row order correctly stayed sorted. All of these now persist across a view switch exactly like the row order already did — a view switch no longer resets sort-related state at all, only genuinely view-specific state (filters, highlighting, collapse state, CAA visibility).

Fixed body zebra striping (the alternating per-value-change background shade in a sorted column, as opposed to the column header's own tint) getting lost specifically after visiting the Complete (merged) view, persisting for one further view switch even after leaving it. Both the merged-view row-combining pass and the pass that restores a table's rows when leaving merged view are separate code paths from the normal render pipeline and were never re-applying the active sort's tint to their own freshly-inserted rows; they now do.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Shortened the four discography-view buttons on artist-releasegroups pages (Complete Discography → Complete, Official Discography → Official, Non-Official Discography → Non-Official, Complete Discography (merged) → Complete (merged)) and added a shared "Discography:" label after the button-group divider so the repeated word only appears once.
